fixes.problem: Subject is a small white pebble over a giant cartoon hand on a blank navy sky; no clear 'coin', no hook object, dead upper half.
fixes.fix: Re-prompt: a large gold coin with lion relief, rim-lit and glowing, hovering over the palm filling the upper third; or open on the real-coin macro with the hook caption.

fixes.problem: Same split gold/silver egg shape held about 3 s, no lion stamp, reads as an egg or shield.
fixes.fix: Cut to 1.5 s beats: add a push-in crop on the gold half then the silver half, or swap in a second image.

fixes.problem: Two coins on a grey paddle shape; unclear object, flat and sticker-like.
fixes.fix: Re-prompt: two stamped coins, gold and silver, on dark cloth with rim light and shadow; no paddle.

fixes.problem: Short-sleeved V-neck white tunic reads as a modern T-shirt; face drawn differently in close-up and full-body shots.
fixes.fix: Re-prompt in a long-sleeved wool chiton with woven border, no V-neck; derive close-ups by cropping the full-body image instead of regenerating.

fixes.problem: Caption sits dead-centre over the focal point (OFF over the pot, STAMP A LION over the stamp).
fixes.fix: Shift the caption block lower to about 72-75% height, still above the bottom 20%, or shift the subject up by 8%.

fixes.problem: Same real-coin photo used four times, cropped at the left and right edges, with the bottom 40% an empty navy void.
fixes.fix: Use a different macro crop for each (bull, lion eye, whole coin at 90% width), add a slow push-in, and centre the coin vertically.

fixes.problem: Giant finger on black plus a blurred head looks AI-warped, and the streak reads as a smear.
fixes.fix: Re-prompt as a touchstone with a thin gold streak, crisp hand scale, no head behind.

worst_frame: frame0 (0 s): small pebble, blank navy sky and an oversized hand give no clear coin and no hook.
